strings.name: Ben Okri
strings.summary: Okri grew up between Nigeria and Britain; civil war and urban poverty shaped his literary outlook. In The Famished Road, spirit-child Azaro moves between material and spiritual worlds; the novel won the 1991 Booker Prize. His fiction, poetry and drama connect African oral traditions with politics, ecological crisis and artistic imagination.
